ValidationRule.description: prevents editing timecards that have been approved
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL( Timesheet__r.Status__c , "Pending") || PRIORVALUE(Timesheet_Status__c) = "Pending" || ISPICKVAL( Timesheet__r.Status__c , "Approved") || PRIORVALUE(Timesheet_Status__c) = "Approved") && (ISCHANGED( Date__c ) || ISCHANGED( Hours__c ) || ISCHANGED( Type__c ) || ISCHANGED( Description_of_Work__c ) || ISCHANGED( Assignment__c ) || ISCHANGED( Project_Line_Item__c )) && NOT( $Permission.Edit_TImecards_Once_Approved )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot edit this timecard once it has been approved. Contact the delivery manager through chatter on this timecard if you need to make edits.
